name: process-mining
description: Agent skills for process mining event logs with the pmx CLI

interface.shortDescription: Build event logs from your systems and mine them with pmx
interface.longDescription: Turn the history a system already keeps - Salesforce stage and field history, Jira or Linear changelogs, GitHub pull request timelines, Claude Code sessions, or a spreadsheet of status dates - into an event log, and check it can be mined before anything is drawn from it. Then answer how the process actually runs with the pmx CLI over pm4py: case, activity and variant counts, case durations, the most common paths and how concentrated they are, exact directly-follows counts, and a mined Petri net or BPMN model rendered as an image, filtered to the frequent variants when the full model is unreadable, plus object-centric logs that have no single case id.
defaultPrompt: What does the process in this event log look like?
How do our support tickets actually flow? They're in Jira
Turn our Salesforce deal history into an event log
